description: The 'Plan & Validation Metadata' section of a flow PR body shows 'Agent: N/A' and 'Model: N/A'. _plan_metadata_lines in pr_metadata.py reads agent and model from the plan stage payload or the intent, neither of which carries them, although the flow context holds the planning agent and model and the plan id encodes them. Its only caller, _semantic_pr_text in review/ensemble.py, hands over just the plan stage payload.
goal: Make the PR body name the real runner. In review/ensemble.py, _semantic_pr_text passes the plan metadata together with the flow context's agent and model, with any agent or model already present in the plan payload taking precedence. In pr_metadata.py, _plan_metadata_lines renders those values and writes N/A only for a value that is genuinely absent from the plan payload, the supplied runner and the intent. The title, summary, key changes and references sections are unchanged. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show; do not add docstrings or comments to the changed functions, and leave existing ones in untouched code alone.
rationale: A PR that reports Agent N/A and Model N/A hides which runner produced the plan, although the flow knows it.
acceptance_criteria: A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/github/test_pr_metadata.py builds the body from a plan payload shaped like the real Stage 2 payload (plan_id 'P-1795696276-CLA-CO5.5' and an ev) plus agent 'claude-agent' and model 'claude-opus-5-5', and asserts the body contains '- **Agent:** `claude-agent`' and '- **Model:** `claude-opus-5-5`' and no 'N/A' in those two lines.
A test proves a value present in the plan payload wins over the supplied runner, and that Agent and Model render N/A only when no source supplies them.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_ensemble.py proves _semantic_pr_text on a FlowContext with agent 'claude-agent' and model 'claude-opus-5-5' and a plan stage result returns a body showing those two values.

All tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/github/test_pr_metadata.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_ensemble.py pass via 'uv run pytest', and the changed modules apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/github/pr_metadata.py and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/ensemble.py pass 'uv run task lint'.
